overview: Convergent mixed-methods evaluation of a six-week video group exercise programme: a quantitative strand using routine outcomes for every starter and a qualitative strand of semi-structured interviews, integrated at analysis in a joint display.
population: Adults with knee osteoarthritis who start the video programme between March 2026 and March 2027 (about 110 expected); interview participants sampled from starters and non-completers.
exposure: Six weeks of physiotherapist-led video group exercise, two 45-minute sessions a week, up to eight participants, with a technology check and loaned tablets where needed.
procedures: KOOS-12 and the remote chair stand test at baseline, six weeks and three months; non-completers are telephoned at three months for KOOS-12. Interviews of 30 to 45 minutes by a physiotherapist who did not run the participant's group, by telephone or video, with interpreters where needed. Sampling targets people over 75, people without home broadband, people with limited English and non-completers.

outcomes.name: KOOS-12 summary score change
outcomes.measure: Change from baseline to three months among all starters
outcomes.why: Patient-reported knee pain, function and quality of life; comparable with trial evidence.

outcomes.name: 30-second chair stand test
outcomes.measure: Number of stands by video call with a camera check
outcomes.why: Objective function measure that agrees with clinic testing.

outcomes.name: Completion by subgroup
outcomes.measure: Proportion attending at least 10 of 12 sessions, by age group, internet access and language
outcomes.why: Shows who the format works for.

outcomes.name: Adverse events during home exercise
outcomes.measure: Falls or injuries reported at each session and at three months
outcomes.why: Home exercise without a physiotherapist in the room may carry risk.

feasibility: Routine data for about 110 starters; 16 to 20 interviews within 3 hours per week of protected time; finishes by June 2027.
biasMitigation: Outcomes sought from non-completers by telephone
Interviewer independent of the participant's group
Purposive sampling of non-completers and digitally excluded participants

biasFlags.label: Missing outcomes for non-completers
biasFlags.note: Telephone follow-up and reporting of the number missing.

biasFlags.label: Regression to the mean after a long wait
biasFlags.note: No comparison group; interpret change cautiously.

biasFlags.label: Social desirability in interviews
biasFlags.note: Independent interviewer and assurance that answers do not affect care.

flags: One primary outcome for the quantitative strand; the qualitative strand has its own question
parsimony.simplestPath: Routine outcomes for all starters plus 16 to 20 interviews, joined in one joint display.

theoreticalFramework: Theoretical framework of acceptability for the interview guide; no other framework.
summary: Convergent design with one primary outcome, one secondary, one process and one balancing measure, plus interviews.
